collection: Département des Manuscrits - Fonds Arabe & Latin

manuscripts.title_arabic: كتاب التصريف لمن عجز عن التأليف
manuscripts.title_translit: Kitāb al-Taṣrīf li-man ʿajiza ʿan al-taʾlīf
manuscripts.author: Ebû'l-Kâsım ez-Zehrâvî (Abulcasis)
manuscripts.illustration_description: Full color pigments and carbon black instrument schematics with Arabic marginal annotations.
manuscripts.subject: Medicine & Surgery
manuscripts.historical_importance: One of the earliest and best preserved copies of the surgical section with rubricated captions for clinical intervention instruments.
references: De Slane, Catalogue des manuscrits arabes de la Bibliothèque nationale, Paris, 1883

manuscripts.author: Ziyâüddîn Ebû Muhammed Abdullâh b. Ahmed el-Mâlekî (İbnü'l-Baytâr)
manuscripts.illustration_description: Comprehensive alphabetical botanical listings with synonyms in Arabic, Berber, Latin, Romance, and Persian.
manuscripts.subject: Pharmacognosy & Medicinal Botany
manuscripts.latin_translation: Simplicius Medicamentis (translated partially into Latin and German)
manuscripts.historical_importance: Contains 1,400+ medicinal substances, correcting Dioscorides and Galen based on empirical botanical field expeditions across the Mediterranean.
references: Leclerc, L., Traité des simples par Ibn el-Beïthar, 3 vols, Paris, 1877-1883

manuscripts.title_arabic: فصل المقال فيما بين الحكمة والشريعة من الاتصال
manuscripts.title_translit: Faṣl al-Maqāl fī-mā bayna al-Ḥikma wa-al-Sharīʿa min al-Ittiṣāl
manuscripts.author: İbn Rüşd (Averroes)
manuscripts.subject: Philosophy of Religion & Epistemology
manuscripts.latin_translation: Hebrew translation by Todros Todrosi (1340), Latin Renaissance editions
manuscripts.historical_importance: Foundational treatise arguing that the pursuit of philosophy and rational demonstration is not merely permitted but legally obligatory (wājib) for qualified minds.
references: Hourani, G. F., Averroes on the Harmony of Religion and Philosophy, London, 1961

manuscripts.author: Abulcasis (translated by Gerard of Cremona)
manuscripts.illustration_description: Illuminated initials and marginal red-black instrument pen drawings adapting Arabic prototypes for European hospital surgeons.
manuscripts.subject: Medieval Surgery
manuscripts.latin_translation: Direct primary witness of the 12th c. Toledo Latin translation
manuscripts.historical_importance: Used as the official textbook in the medical faculties of Montpellier, Bologna, and Paris.
references: Jacquart, D., La médecine médiévale dans le cadre parisien, Paris, 1998
